Hi Laura — thanks, and great questions. Below is the concise Q&A your security team can use. I'll also attach a one-page summary and the dataflow diagram (attached).

Q: What's the default retention window for request/response logs (prompts + model outputs) on Redwood Hosted?
A: Default retention is 30 days for raw request/response content. This includes prompt text, completions, and associated request metadata (timestamps, model id, token counts). Logs are retained for quality monitoring, abuse detection, and to support incident investigations.

Q: Are prompts/outputs used for model improvement?
A: By default, data may be used internally to improve safety and model quality at an aggregate level. Customers may opt out of any use for model training or improvement via an account setting or contractual clause; opting out will stop data from being included in training pipelines.

Q: How does retention differ for Dedicated and Private deployments?
A: Dedicated: retention is configurable and typically set in the contract (30 days is common but we can extend/shorten per customer need). Private (VPC/on-prem): Redwood does not collect or transmit customer request/response logs to our control plane unless explicitly enabled — the customer controls storage and retention.

Q: If FinBank requests deletion, what's the timeline and scope of deletion?
A: We perform deletion in stages: 1) We mark the records for deletion immediately and remove them from live indexes within 24 hours. 2) Backend storage and caches are purged within 48–72 hours. 3) Residual copies in external backups are removed on the next backup cycle; we guarantee logical removal from primary systems within 72 hours and physical removal from backups within the backup retention cycle documented in the contract (typically 30–90 days unless a stricter clause is included).

Q: Are there any residual logs we retain for auditing?
A: Operational audit logs (who called the delete API, admin actions, delivery failures) are retained for 90 days for incident traceability; these do not contain prompt text or model outputs.

Q: Data residency — where are logs stored?
A: For hosted customers, request/response logs are stored in the region selected at account creation (we currently offer US and EU regions). For Dedicated, logs can be routed to customer-dedicated zones. Private deployments remain under customer control and follow their on-prem/VPC residency.

Q: Embeddings / derived artifacts — are those retained differently?
A: Embeddings are treated as derived artifacts. For hosted customers, embeddings are retained under the same retention policy as request/response unless specifically excluded. Customers can opt to never persist embeddings via account configuration.

Q: How do we prove deletion?
A: We provide: 1) a deletion confirmation (timestamp + request id), 2) an internal purge log showing stage completions, and 3) an attestation for contractual requests. For enterprise customers we can coordinate an audit if needed.

If it helps, I can provide suggested questionnaire language your team can drop into their intake. Connor / Lauren — recommend we convert the attached doc into the customer-facing FAQ and send on FinBank letterhead.

— Evelyn

Laura — quick clarifications: good catches.

1) Opt-out behavior: when you opt out of model-improvement, the data remains in primary storage subject to the retention window unless you also request deletion. Opting out only prevents the data from entering our model-training/annotation pipelines; it does not automatically delete historical content. If you want both opt-out and periodic purging we recommend a retention clause (e.g., 30 days) plus opt-out enabled.

2) Deletion confirmation: yes — we include the deletion request id, account id, timestamp, and the list of record ids removed. We'll provide the format in the customer FAQ.

3) 72-hour purge guarantee: for standard hosted accounts we commit to logical removal from primary systems within 72 hours after a deletion request, except in cases of active legal hold or ongoing security incident where we will notify the customer and provide an expected timeline. We will not extend the purge for operational reasons without notification and written justification.

Next steps: Connor / Lauren — can you prepare a one-page FAQ on FinBank letterhead that consolidates the Q&A and includes the deletion confirmation sample? I'll review and sign off. Laura — happy to set a 30-minute call if you prefer to go over the language.

— Evelyn
